cost.stageRooflineHelp: Each domain's action vector run through the roofline, taking the max of the five paths; a theoretical lower bound (estimate). Small models dominated by kernel-launch overhead fall well below measured time. First version covers compute + memory per stage; communication stays at the whole-model level.
cost.disclaimer: Theoretical calculation; not simulation or prediction
cost.independent: P/D workloads, node counts, and parallel plans are saved independently; only the current phase is shown.
cost.theoretical: Cost is a theoretical estimate of graph-resident memory (weights, KV, KDA, declared buffers). Activation workspace, CUDA runtime, and comm scratch are runtime-unknown and not included. Roofline times are lower bounds. No scheduling, pipeline bubble, or transfer overlap simulation.
cost.chunkedSummary: Total uses {total} input tokens; peak uses {peak} tokens per chunk.
cost.parallelDefault: Default suggestion: up to 8 GPUs on one node, using {cards} GPUs (TP{cards}).
cost.parallelDefaultNoFit: Default suggestion: even single-node TP8 does not fit; add nodes and adjust PP/parallelism, or choose other hardware.
cost.parallelDefaultUnknown: Default deployment: one node with 8 GPUs; the model or hardware lacks enough theoretical memory data to choose a smaller tier.
cost.parallelDefaultBasis: Based on batch=1, 2048 tokens, model weight precision and the current framework accounting; excludes runtime workspace, not a deployment guarantee. P/D each use a separate node.
cost.parallelAuto: Automatic recommendation is active; editing parallelism, nodes, or GPUs per node keeps the manual configuration.
cost.parallelManual: Manual deployment is active; hardware changes and background checkpoint updates will not overwrite it.
cost.kvBytesPerElementHelp: Fallback only: explicit node/cache dtype declarations (for example DSA index dtype) take precedence.
cost.interNodeBandwidthHelp: Public cards lack an inter_node spec, so inter-node comm time is unknown. Enter a user-estimated effective bandwidth (GB/s; multiplied by η.comm into the roofline comm-time lower bound). Leave blank to keep it unknown. Measured reference: single rail ≈ 9.95 GB/s (79.6 Gb/s). Affects the comm-time estimate only; not a measurement.
cost.speculativeHelp: Optional SGLang target-verify workload (CUDA, top-k=1, ReplaySSM off). Use each attention worker's effective request capacity after runtime caps, excluding the padding slot, not the unadjusted CLI max-running-requests. Both positive: include scratch in VRAM, Fit, Max Context and PD decode Fit. PD prefill skips verify; scratch is not transferred. Both zero: unconfigured; incomplete inputs remain unknown.

valueSource.title: Weight-carrying nodes by value origin: checkpoint truth vs config-derived estimate

eta.detail: Vector/SFU rates are computed at 100% efficiency (rates.js falls back to eta.vector ?? 1 / eta.sfu ?? 1; resolveEfficiency does not emit these keys, so neither the sliders nor chip-level declarations reach them). ηF defaults to 0.7 as an adjustable assumption (principles §3.6) with no separate vector/SFU discount, so 1.0 is an explicit optimistic upper bound, not a measurement. The ηF slider does not affect vector/SFU paths.
